scenes.script: Amol says: Jevha pan English bolaychi vel yaychi, mi freeze vhaycho. Mistake honyachi khup bhiti vataychi.
scenes.on_screen_text: English bolaychi bhiti vatte? Mistake honyachi tension aahe?

scenes.script:
Amol says: Mag mala bhetla Supernova AI. Mazi AI teacher, Miss Nova, maza level analyze karun mazyasathi personalized plan banavte.
Amol says: Ani ho, mi private madhe practice karu shakto. Koni baghat nahi, ani tya kadhi judge karat nahit.
scenes.on_screen_text: Bheta Supernova AI la! Tumchya personal AI teacher sobat kadhihi speaking practice kara.

scenes.script: Amol says: Ata mi fakt textbooks nahi vachat. Mi actually out loud bolto, Miss Nova ani Snehal sarkhya dusrya learners sobat practice karto.
scenes.on_screen_text: Out loud bola ani supportive community sobat practice kara!

scenes.script:
Amol says: Aamhi real-life situations practice karto, jasa maza Mumbai madhla upcoming job interview.
Amol says: Daily practice mule, maza confidence madhe mala visible progress disayla lagli.
scenes.on_screen_text: Job interview sarkhe real-life scenarios practice kara. Aajach tumchi journey start kara!

scenes.script: Amol says: Scrolling madhe vel waste karna thambva. Supernova AI la daily 15 minutes dya. App download karun bolayla start kara!
scenes.on_screen_text: Fakt daily 15 minutes. Aajach Supernova AI download kara!

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Ensured the hook opens with a native Marathi word ('Jevha') to catch attention. Re-cast characters to Amol and Snehal per the Marathi casting table. Maintained polite plural forms ('dya', 'kara') for viewer-facing lines and respectful forms for Miss Nova ('tya kadhi judge karat nahit'). Kept numbers as English numerals ('15 minutes') and heavily code-mixed the script to match natural WhatsApp-style spoken Marathi.

safety.summary: The ad is fully compliant with all brand-safety guardrails, utilizing approved personal testimonials, safe privacy framing, and generic behavior-change hooks without any prohibited claims or hard pricing.
